# GAT App

> A centralized gateway to all GAT services.

## Overview
GAT App is a centralized gateway web application providing quick access to various GAT services and tools, complete with passcode-protected administration settings.

## Core Features
- Centralized dashboard for accessing GAT web tools and external resources.
- Customizable sidebar navigation buttons and content embeds.
- System Settings administration panel for dynamic button and content management.

## Links
- [Home](/home): Main dashboard and home view.
- [System Settings](/settings): Administration panel for managing links, content embeds, and settings.
